import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

N = int(data[0])
Q = int(data[1])

# Read the initial matrix B
B = []
index = 2
for _ in range(N):
    row = list(map(int, data[index:index + N]))
    B.append(row)
    index += N

# Function to reconstruct the sequence A from matrix B
def reconstruct_sequence(B):
    A = [0] * N
    for j in range(1, N):
        A[j] = B[0][j]
        for i in range(j):
            A[j] = min(A[j], A[i] + B[i][j])
    return A

# Reconstruct the initial sequence
initial_sequence = reconstruct_sequence(B)
print(" ".join(map(str, initial_sequence)))

# Process each query
for _ in range(Q):
    p = int(data[index]) - 1
    index += 1
    new_values = list(map(int, data[index:index + N]))
    index += N
    
    # Update the matrix B for the query
    for i in range(N):
        B[i][p] = new_values[i]
        B[p][i] = new_values[i]
    
    # Reconstruct the sequence after the update
    updated_sequence = reconstruct_sequence(B)
    print(" ".join(map(str, updated_sequence)))
